method: Live end-to-end HTTP smoke test against a booted dev server, driving one real prompt through all 12 phases in pipeline order. Script: reports/final-integration-smoke-test.mjs (re-runnable).
samplePrompt: Build a hotel booking platform with room search, online payments, staff roles and email confirmations

pipelineStages.phase: Phase 4 — Database Designer & API Contract Generator

pipelineStages.notes: 234 nodes, 465 edges, 0 circular dependencies, 100% token savings on a scoped change
history and statistics endpoints confirmed consistent with the generation just run
project created, generation logged, dashboard reflects it, manifest exported
12 targets supported, 5 health-check endpoints generated, complete-zip export produced 19 files
score 93/100 (A), production-ready tier, 16 test files at 100% coverage estimate, all 10 docs generated, cached GET endpoints byte-identical to the POST /analyze response
Both respond with a clean 501/handled error rather than crashing — auth (Phase 3) and review (Phase 2 code-review pass) are intentionally unimplemented scaffolds, not broken endpoints

jsonSchemaValidation.method: Every response was parsed as JSON and checked for its documented required fields before the next stage consumed it as input; a shape mismatch would have failed the pipeline at the next stage's validator (422) rather than silently propagating bad data.

moduleContractCheck.method: grep audit of every import statement under server/src/modules for references to a sibling module's internals (anything other than ../../shared or the module's own relative paths)
moduleContractCheck.note: The only near-matches were generated-code template strings inside the backend/frontend generators and Security Engine (import statements the GENERATED downstream app will contain, not real imports in NexArch's own module graph).

findings.description: The same ~6-line slugify algorithm was independently reimplemented 12 times (9 client feature pages, 3 server modules) instead of using the shared string utilities that already existed for this purpose.
findings.detail: Consolidated into server/src/shared/utils/strings.ts (slugify, alongside the pre-existing kebabCase/pascalCase/snakeCase/camelCase) and client/src/shared/lib/slugify.ts. All 12 call sites updated to the shared implementation with equivalent options (maxLength/fallback) preserving exact prior behavior. Re-verified: 227/227 tests still pass, tsc/eslint clean, production build succeeded with a small bundle-size reduction.

findings.description: The Dashboard's "Modules online" stat read 14/14 but 15 modules are actually registered (it omitted the `auth` scaffold from its hint list while including the equally-unimplemented `review` scaffold).
findings.detail: Corrected to 13/15, with the hint text now explicitly naming auth and review as reserved scaffolds rather than silently omitting one of them.

findings.description: All 227 automated tests are server-side (node:test). The NexArch client itself has no automated frontend test suite (Vitest/Testing Library) — it generates one for downstream projects (Phase 12) but doesn't consume that capability on itself.
findings.detail: Out of scope for this integration pass (would be new test authoring, not verification/polish of existing work). Recorded as a recommendation in quality-summary.json.
